subject: SOC 2: pen test artifacts upload and GRC portal checklist
messages:
From: Jamie Ross <jross@cloudwave-secops.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com, Elena Vasquez <elena@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request: pen test report upload & mapping

Hi Lauren,

As part of our upcoming SOC 2 review (Security category) we need the penetration test artifacts you referenced on the intake form. Specifically CloudWave requires: 
- Redacted penetration test report (executive summary + high-level findings) suitable for external auditors
- A findings matrix mapping each pen-test finding to remediation evidence or accepted risk
- A short remediation statement summarizing fixes, owners, and ETA for open items

Please upload these files to the GRC portal linked below and add entries to the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet columns labeled "PenTestArtifactProvided". Our auditor deadline is Feb 25; can you confirm by EOD Feb 19?

Portal link: https://grc.redwood.example.com/requests/CloudWave-4582
SIG/CAIQ sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2b3Cpt-evidence-matrix

We will accept redacted PDFs for the public report and an internal appendix for technical evidence (uploaded to the portal but flagged as internal). If you have a locator (DocuSign or drive) for the full technical appendix, include that in the portal notes.

Thanks,
Jamie Ross
Security Assessment Lead
CloudWave Technologies

Attachment requested: pen-test-scope.pdf
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ross <jross@cloudwave-secops.com>
Cc: Elena Vasquez <elena@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request: pen test report upload & mapping

Hi Jamie —

On Thu, Feb 18, 2027 at 09:12 AM, Jamie Ross <jross@cloudwave-secops.com> wrote:
> As part of our upcoming SOC 2 review (Security category) we need the penetration test artifacts you referenced on the intake form.

Thanks for the clear list. We will provide the artifacts requested and target the Feb 19 confirmation for portal upload. Quick summary of plan: 

- Attached: redacted executive summary (redwood-pt-exec-summary-2027-02-redacted.pdf) and remediation statement (remediation-statement-CloudWave-20270218.docx).
- Internal tech appendix with raw findings and evidence will be prepared and uploaded to the portal but marked as internal access only. Karhthik will coordinate the redactions for any customer-identifying test data.
- We will populate the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet column "PenTestArtifactProvided" and include links to the portal records.

Two asks for you: 
1) Is your auditor comfortable with the executive summary + internal appendix approach? If not, tell us what level of technical detail must be visible in the public artifact.
2) Please confirm whether the auditor needs the full unredacted report on a secure transfer (SFTP) versus only being able to view it inside the portal as "internal".

Icc: Karhthik Iyer (engineering security) and Stephanie Nguyen (compliance ops) to own redaction and upload.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0124

Attachments: redwood-pt-exec-summary-2027-02-redacted.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), remediation-statement-CloudWave-20270218.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 evidence request: pen test report upload & mapping

Team — forwarding CloudWave's ask and my reply. Action items: 

- Karthik: run the redaction checklist on the internal appendix (PII/customer artifacts). Produce "pt-finding-matrix-2027-02.xlsx" with a column for AuditorEvidenceLink and Jira ticket. Mark items that are still open and include short mitigation notes.
- Stephanie: when Karthik calls a finding "addressed" create portal record and set access=external; for "internal" mark accordingly and add the secure SFTP note. Update the SIG/CAIQ sheet and tick PenTestArtifactProvided=yes for the exec summary and matrix.

Please confirm by COB Feb 19. If you run into redaction blockers, escalate to me immediately — CloudWave's auditor is strict about test data.

Thanks,
Lauren

Hi all,

Upload summary and status: 
- redwood-pt-exec-summary-2027-02-redacted.pdf: uploaded to portal, access=external (auditor-friendly).
- pt-finding-matrix-2027-02.xlsx: uploaded to portal and linked in SIG spreadsheet. Columns populated: FindingID, Severity, RemediationOwner, JiraTicket, AuditorEvidenceLink.
- remediation-statement-CloudWave-20270218.docx: uploaded to portal.
- Technical appendix (internal): uploaded to portal under Internal Evidence (access restricted). Full SFTP transfer is available on request; noted in portal comments.

Remediation status: 8 findings total — 5 closed (patches and config changes), 3 open (mitigations in place, ETA 2027-03-10). Jira tickets: SEC-1121 (closed), SEC-1122 (closed), SEC-1123 (closed), SEC-1124 (open, ETA 3/10), SEC-1125 (open, ETA 3/10), SEC-1126 (open, ETA 3/10), plus two low-severity items now archived. I put short remediation notes in the matrix rows.

Next steps: Stephanie will set the SIG/CAIQ sheet column to "Yes" for provided artifacts and add the portal record IDs. Lauren, please confirm with CloudWave if they need the SFTP transfer of the unredacted appendix; otherwise the internal portal copy should be sufficient for their auditor to complete mapping.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
